extraction.Name: Eliza Dyer
extraction.Recorded patent: patent was recorded July 14, 1919 by C. L. Dice
extraction.Buyer: Eliza Dyer Dearinger and Ben Dearinger conveyed the land to Orville R. Howell for $3600.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612674 issued; southeast quarter of Section 4, township 39, range 28; There is no receipt of record; conveyance dated July 11, 1919; allottee also known as Eliza Dyer Dearinger, formerly Eliza Dyer, married to Ben Dearinger
